name: Sundram Fasteners Ltd
title: Sundram Fasteners Ltd - 500403 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: FY26 revenue up 7% to INR 5,612 cr and PBT before exceptionals up 12% to INR 750 cr, but exports fell ~8% for the year and capex is revenue-growth driven at 70% with no capacity cut or deferral.

capex.quote: Sundram has been investing not less than INR 300 crores year-on-year. Typically, 25% to 30% is for replacement. The balance 70% would be driven by customer requirements across all our plants.

triggers.label: Class 8 orders nearly double YoY in Q1
triggers.quote: the Class 8 truck preliminary orders were almost double that of the year ago period

triggers.label: Exports to grow 15-20% in FY27
triggers.quote: that's why we are looking at a growth of about 15% to 20% this year

triggers.label: Railway run-rate INR 2-3 cr/month to INR 100 cr/yr
triggers.quote: we see a visibility of it taking up to INR 100 crores

triggers.label: EV programmes downsized, GM EV cut 50%
triggers.quote: they have downsized their EV projections by 50%

guidance.quote: our aim is to have a double-digit growth in the coming 2 years
we are looking at a growth of about 15% to 20% this year
we are looking at 8% growth in the commercial vehicle segment and 10% in the passenger vehicle segment
we've been distributing 30% of the profit after tax consistently
we are looking at this number. But I think by Q3, Q4, we should be able to look at this

red_flags.label: EV programme downsizing at US OEMs
red_flags.quote: they have downsized their EV projections by 50%

red_flags.label: Gross margin compression post West Asia conflict
red_flags.quote: there has been an inflation in the RM and direct materials to some extent. And so it has got slightly compressed

evasions.quote: Can you please share your email id, we will give you the information.
it has not taken off in a manner which we would have desired but I think these are cycles
